# stormsia/proxy-list — AI Agent & LLM Documentation (llms.txt)

> Zero-auth, continuously audited public proxy infrastructure. Filtered every 60 seconds by the multi-threaded Hydra Rust validation engine and published directly to GitHub CDN.

## Project Summary

**stormsia/proxy-list** is an open-source, machine-readable repository of actively validated proxy servers across 239 countries. The system solves the "stale proxy" problem by replacing static scrapers with Hydra, a high-concurrency Rust engine that performs TCP socket handshakes, TLS negotiation, round-trip latency (`rtt_total_ms`) benchmarks, and header inspection (`anon`).

- **Homepage**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/stormsia/proxy-list
- **Documentation & Integration Guide**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/docs
- **Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- **Pricing & Free Tier Specification**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/pricing.md
- **Agent Protocol Guidelines**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/AGENTS.md
- **Complete AI Reference & Code Cookbook**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/llms-full.txt
- **License**: MIT (Code) / CC-BY 4.0 (Dataset)

## Direct Data Endpoints

All endpoints are free, unauthenticated, CORS-enabled (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`), and served over GitHub / Fastly global CDN:

| Endpoint | Protocol | Format | Update Rate | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [data/proxies.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/data/proxies.json) | All (HTTP, SOCKS4, SOCKS5) | JSON (flat array) | Every 60s | Complete dataset with latency (ms), uptime %, ASN, ISP, country, and anonymity tier |
| [working_proxies.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/working_proxies.txt) | All | Plain text (`host:port`) | Every 60s | Active working nodes, one per line |
| [socks5.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/socks5.txt) | SOCKS5 | Plain text (`host:port`) | Every 60s | High-anonymity SOCKS5 nodes (TCP/UDP, remote DNS) |
| [socks4.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/socks4.txt) | SOCKS4 | Plain text (`host:port`) | Every 60s | SOCKS4 TCP stream proxy nodes |
| [http.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/http.txt) | HTTP / HTTPS | Plain text (`host:port`) | Every 60s | HTTP and HTTPS CONNECT tunnel proxy nodes |

## Hydra Schema Specification (`data/proxies.json`)

Each entry in `data/proxies.json` is a flat JSON object:

```json
{
  "id": "1.10.248.240:80",
  "ip": "1.10.248.240",
  "port": 80,
  "url": "http://1.10.248.240:80",
  "protocol": "http",
  "has_auth": false,
  "auth_user": null,
  "auth_pass": null,
  "state": "alive",
  "supports_https": true,
  "out_ip": "1.10.248.240",
  "country": "TH",
  "asn": 23969,
  "asn_org": "TOT Public Company Limited",
  "anon": "anonymous",
  "rtt_tcp_ms": 227,
  "rtt_handshake_ms": 313,
  "rtt_total_ms": 540,
  "uptime_pct": 98.5,
  "stability_pct": 100.0,
  "stability_window_min": 5,
  "checks_total": 45,
  "checks_success": 44,
  "dead_strikes": 0,
  "last_error": null,
  "first_seen_at": 1795224444,
  "last_checked_at": 1795248007,
  "next_check_at": 1795248067
}
```

### Anonymity Levels (`anon`)
- `elite` (Level 1): Client IP is completely hidden; no proxy headers (`Via`, `X-Forwarded-For`) forwarded. Target servers cannot distinguish traffic from a direct visitor.
- `anonymous` (Level 2): Client IP is hidden, but the server knows a proxy is being used.
- `transparent` (Level 3): Client IP is transmitted in `X-Forwarded-For`. Useful only for caching or non-sensitive scraping.

## AI Agent Decision Matrix

When building autonomous agents or scripts that consume this data:
1. **Low Latency Workloads**: Filter by `p.rtt_total_ms < 800` and `p.state === "alive"`.
2. **Stealth & Anti-Bot Resilience**: Select `p.protocol === "socks5"` and `p.anon === "elite"`. Always configure remote DNS resolution (`socks5h://`) to eliminate DNS leak signatures.
3. **Geo-Targeting**: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 `p.country` (e.g. `"US"`, `"DE"`, `"JP"`, `"GB"`).
4. **Reliability Guarantee**: Filter by `(p.uptime_pct || 0) >= 85.0` to filter out volatile nodes.
5. **Failover Handling**: Implement retry backoff on HTTP status `429` (Rate Limited) and `403` (Forbidden), rotating to the next node in the pool.

## Quick Integration Snippets

### cURL (SOCKS5 with Remote DNS)
```bash
curl -x socks5h://1.10.248.240:1080 https://httpbin.org/ip --connect-timeout 8
```

### Python (`httpx` + `data/proxies.json`)
```python
import httpx

proxies = httpx.get("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/data/proxies.json").json()
alive_socks5 = [p for p in proxies if p["state"] == "alive" and p["protocol"] == "socks5" and (p["rtt_total_ms"] or 9999) < 1000]

if alive_socks5:
    node = alive_socks5[0]
    client = httpx.Client(proxy=f"socks5://{node['ip']}:{node['port']}", timeout=10.0)
    print("Routed via proxy:", client.get("https://httpbin.org/ip").json())
```

For complete, multi-language implementations (Node.js, Go, Rust, Playwright, Scrapy), detailed quantile benchmarks, and architecture diagrams, see [llms-full.txt](https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/llms-full.txt).
